# Sine-Gordon theory: the rank-one template {#sec-sine-gordon}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon=false title="Learning goals"}
- Find the kink, antikink and breather solutions and their masses.
- Compute the one-loop soliton mass by the DHN method.
- Derive and analyse the Zamolodchikov soliton S-matrix and its breather poles.
- Identify the lowest breather with the elementary particle (breather–particle identification).
- See the $U_q(\widehat{sl}_2)$ symmetry and its RSOS restriction to perturbed minimal models.
- Contrast sine-Gordon with sinh-Gordon, the real-coupling $a_1^{(1)}$ theory.
:::
